title: Keep section letters separate from section text
scope: Retain both GPIF Section.Letter and Section.Text while preserving an explicit compatibility rule for Marker.Title.
acceptance: Parse a section with Letter=A and Text=Verse without losing either value.
Keep empty letter, empty text and both-present cases distinct, including Unicode/XML-sensitive text.
Post-parse edits follow the documented authority rule and the independent GP8 consumer sees both fields.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage. Focused regression: ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 go test ./... -run "^(TestSectionAndTrackNames|TestSectionTitlePublicEdits|TestShortNamePublicPresenceAndPolicy|TestConformanceSectionTrackNames|TestAlphaTabSectionTrackNames)$". The original synthetic fixture and canonical receipt are committed; full probe refresh remains part of root integration.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Exact field/wire/runtime claims, nonmutation, occurrence ownership, legacy authority and consumer-loss policy.
Exact raw and final pinned-consumer values are independently asserted; final empty-name derivation is an explicit limit.
Hash-bound synthetic source and exact exported source/edit/empty/whitespace consumer facts and reports.

resolution: Implemented independent Marker.Letter/Marker.Text and legacy Title reconciliation. Parsed Title edits override text while preserving the letter; conflicting simultaneous edits receive gp8.normalize.section-title. Empty versus absent sections, Unicode/XML-sensitive text, programmatic captions, and exact final pinned-consumer values are covered. Narrow boundary-whitespace loss for CDATA terminators is reported explicitly. Awaiting independent final-commit review and root combined gates.
